text: Let no one however, relying on this example, delay conciliating the people till danger has actually come... For the mass of the people will consider that they have to thank not him, but his enemies, and that there is ground to fear that when the danger has passed away, he will take back what he gave under compulsion, and, therefore, that to him they lie under no obligation.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
